access.lockedTimer: Started by {{name}}. Only they or a parent can change it.
access.lockedEntry: Added by {{name}}. Only they or a parent can change it.
access.controlOnly: Started by {{name}}. You can pause or stop it; only they or a parent can change the rest.

doctor.name: Dr. {{name}}
doctor.settingsNotice: You are {{name}}'s doctor: you can read everything logged, write notes and add consultation measurements. The parents manage everything else.

profile.intro: Pediatricians and other doctors declare it here. A family can then invite you to their baby with the Doctor role.
profile.selfDeclaredNotice: Self-declared: Lotties does not check registrations. Families see “Self-declared doctor” next to your name.
profile.displayNameHelp: Without a title: families see “Dr.” before it.
profile.displayNameRequired: Enter the name families will see.
profile.registrationNumberHelp: For example your CRM. Families can see it.
profile.loadFailed: Could not load your professional profile. Check your connection.

invite.consent: The doctor who accepts will see the sections you choose for {{name}} and can add notes and measurements. You can change what you share or remove access at any time.

inviteAccept.title: Join as the baby's doctor
inviteAccept.body: This invite is for a doctor. First tell the family who you are: your profile is self-declared and they see it next to your notes.

members.removeBody: They lose access to {{baby}} immediately. The notes they shared stay visible to the family.

notes.title: Notes
notes.visibilityHelp: Shared notes are seen by everyone who follows the baby. Private notes are only for you.
notes.staysShared: This note is already shared with the parents. To take it back, delete it.
notes.saveFailed: Could not save the note. Try again.
notes.deleteBody: It is removed from your notes.
notes.deleteSharedBody: The parents will no longer see it.
notes.emptyDoctor: Write what the family should remember after a visit for {{name}}. Shared notes appear for the parents.
notes.emptyFamily: Notes from {{name}}'s doctor will appear here.
notes.familyNotice: Notes from {{name}}'s doctor. You can read them; only the doctor who wrote a note can change it.
notes.createBabyFirst: Create a baby first to see notes.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Babies whose families invited you as their doctor.
patients.none: No patients yet. A family adds you with a doctor invite link.

growth.doctorNotice: As {{name}}'s doctor you can add consultation measurements and change your own.

accessLog.title: Access log
accessLog.explainer: When a doctor's app loads {{name}}'s data it is recorded here, at most once an hour. The latest 50 are shown.
accessLog.none: No doctor has opened {{name}}'s data yet.
accessLog.loadFailed: Could not load the access log. Check your connection.

sheet.reviewNote: The parents review it before anything changes.
sheet.saveFailed: Could not save the proposal. Try again.
sheet.alreadyDecided: The parents already decided this proposal, so it can no longer be edited.

chooser.noneYet: The baby's medication list is empty. Search the catalog or type a name.

provenance.originalNote: As the doctor sent it. This is a record: it cannot be edited.

mine.title: My proposals
mine.subtitle: Prescriptions you suggested for {{name}}. Nothing changes until the parents accept.
mine.emptyBody: Prescribe a medicine for {{name}} and the parents get it to accept or decline.
mine.withdrawBody: The parents will no longer see it to accept.
mine.onlyDoctor: Proposals are sent by the baby's doctor.

details.replacesEnds: Accepting ends the current one today.
details.acceptAdds: Accepting adds this prescription to {{name}}. You can end it at any time.
details.addedPending: It shows in the medicines as soon as it syncs.
details.cancelledAccess: Cancelled because the doctor no longer has access.
details.superseded: Replaced when another suggestion for the same prescription was accepted.
details.missing: This suggestion is not on this device yet.
details.decisionFailed: Could not save your decision. Try again.

fromDoctor.title: From your doctor
fromDoctor.subtitle: Prescriptions and recommendations from {{name}}'s doctor. Nothing changes until you accept.
fromDoctor.emptyBody: When {{name}}'s doctor suggests a prescription or sends a recommendation, it shows here.
fromDoctor.parentsOnly: Only the baby's parents see what the doctor sends.
